title: SnowStability
body:
# SnowStability

Slow falling in snowy biomes.

## Features
- Applies SLOW_FALLING under BIOME condition.
- Configurable intervals and amplifier.
- Permission-based access.
- Lightweight scheduled checks.

## Command
- `/snowstability status | /snowstability reload`

## Permissions
- `snowstability.use`
- `snowstability.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
effect: "SLOW_FALLING"
condition:
  type: "BIOME"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
